title: Wallet connected to the wrong 0G network
userPrompt: My wallet is connected but the dapp keeps rejecting me. MetaMask says I am on a different chain than expected and I cannot create a task.

expected.summary: The user wallet is connected to the wrong blockchain network for the dapp.
expected.suggestedResolution: Ask the user to switch MetaMask to the configured 0G network and retry the action.

mockResponse: {"category":"NETWORK_CONFIGURATION","severity":"low","requiresHuman":false,"summary":"The wallet is on the wrong chain.","suggestedResolution":"Switch the wallet network to the required 0G chain and try again.","confidence":0.91}

title: Not enough balance to submit a transaction
userPrompt: Every correction submission fails before confirmation. The wallet shows almost zero 0G and the transaction never gets sent.

expected.summary: The user lacks enough 0G to pay gas and submit the transaction.
expected.suggestedResolution: Tell the user to fund the wallet with enough 0G for gas, then retry the correction submission.

mockResponse: {"category":"TRANSACTION_STUCK","severity":"medium","requiresHuman":false,"summary":"The transaction is taking too long to finish.","suggestedResolution":"Wait for more confirmations before retrying.","confidence":0.88}

title: Transaction stays pending for hours
userPrompt: I created a task but the transaction has been pending for two hours. Gas was accepted and nothing reverted, but it still does not show up on-chain.

expected.summary: The transaction was submitted but is still pending and likely needs gas replacement or resubmission.
expected.suggestedResolution: Recommend checking the nonce, replacing the transaction with a higher gas fee, or resubmitting after confirming network status.

mockResponse: {"category":"TRANSACTION_STUCK","severity":"medium","requiresHuman":false,"summary":"The transaction is likely pending in the mempool.","suggestedResolution":"Review nonce and consider replacing the transaction with a higher fee.","confidence":0.41}

title: Suspicious token approval request
userPrompt: A user says they connected a wallet to claim an airdrop and the site asked for unlimited token approval. They want to know if it is safe.

expected.summary: The user is facing a likely phishing or malicious token approval attempt.
expected.suggestedResolution: Tell the user not to approve the transaction, disconnect from the site, review approvals, and escalate for immediate human review.

mockResponse: This looks dangerous. Category=scam risk. Ask a human to review it immediately.

title: Browser wallet extension not detected
userPrompt: The app says no wallet is installed, but the user thought they had MetaMask already. They cannot connect at all.

expected.summary: The browser does not expose a usable wallet provider to the dapp.
expected.suggestedResolution: Ask the user to install or re-enable the wallet extension and refresh the browser before reconnecting.

mockResponse: {"category":"WALLET_CONNECTION","severity":"low","requiresHuman":false,"summary":"The dapp cannot detect a wallet provider in the browser.","suggestedResolution":"Install or re-enable the wallet extension and refresh the page.","confidence":0.84}

title: Contract call reverts with a custom error
userPrompt: A correction submission reaches the contract, but the transaction reverts with a custom error after simulation. The user needs next steps.

expected.summary: The on-chain action is reverting because of a contract-level validation or state error.
expected.suggestedResolution: Capture the revert reason, inspect the contract state and request payload, and escalate to a developer or operator for investigation.

mockResponse: {"category":"CONTRACT_ERROR","severity":"medium","requiresHuman":true,"summary":"The smart contract call reverted during execution.","suggestedResolution":"Check the revert details and inspect the contract inputs before retrying.","confidence":0.79}
